notes.title: Super Kingcrab Simulator Final Release
notes.notes:
Hello, this is !CyberApex.
We’re here to share the release news of Super Kingcrab Simulator.




Originally, the release date was planned for Q4 2025, but to wrap things up faster, we have decided to officially release it on July 1st.



Thank you for waiting for Super Kingcrab Simulator throughout its development.




Now it's time for some truly tasty gameplay!
Thank you.
